question: What vital composition and life-goal bestowal are attributed to the described syllable?
premises: The syllable consists of the five vital breaths.
The syllable bestows the four aims of life.
These attributes belong to the same syllable.
inference: The syllable composed of five vital breaths bestows the four aims of life.
plain_english: O goddess, it consists of the five vital breaths and bestows the four aims of life.
